description: This file defines a class HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_Background, which validates and processes the shorthand CSS 'background' property within the HTML Purifier library. It handles parsing, validation, and munging of background-related CSS values.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_Background
classes.description: A class for validating shorthand CSS 'background' property values, supporting background-color, background-image, background-repeat, background-attachment, background-position, and background-size.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the validator with configuration data, extracting background-related info from the CSS definition.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a string as a CSS background property value, parsing components, munging rgb() values, and returning the normalized value or false if invalid.
